# Move AI

> > Move AI provides markerless motion capture solutions powered by AI, from single-camera iPhone mocap with Move One to multi-camera studio-grade systems with Move Pro.

Move AI specializes in AI-powered 3D animation tools that eliminate the need for traditional motion capture suits and markers. Their technology enables creators to capture high-quality human motion using consumer devices like iPhones or professional multi-camera setups, with real-time previsualization and advanced hand tracking capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Markerless motion capture
- AI-powered animation
- Move One (single-camera iPhone mocap)
- Move Pro (multi-camera studio solution)
- Dex by Move AI
- Hand tracking
- Real-time previsualization
- 3D character animation
- Mobile mocap (iOS/iPhone/iPad)
- VFX animation
- Keyframe animation
- Crowd simulation
- GoPro integration
- Gen 2 technology

## Motion Capture Products

- [Move One](https://www.move.ai/move-one): Move One: single-camera iPhone mocap for AI-powered 3D animation
- [Move Pro](https://www.move.ai/move-pro): Move Pro: multi-camera studio-grade markerless motion capture solution
